adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` without any `.catch(...)` handler. By contrast, `save()` explicitly does `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the DELETE request fails, there will be no user feedback and the rejected promise is unhandled; the row is only removed inside the `.then`, so it will remain with no error surfaced.
